vaults.setupIntro: Install Synch in Obsidian to start syncing your notes.
vaults.setupSignIn: In Obsidian, open Settings → Synchrun and sign in with {email}.
vaults.setupCreateBody: In Synch settings, choose Create vault, set a vault password, and keep it safe.
vaults.setupConnectBody: Open the local vault you want to sync and back it up. In Synch settings, choose Connect vault, select “{name}”, and enter its vault password. Use the existing vault instead of creating another one.
vaults.setupVerify: Keep Obsidian open for the first sync. Check sync status in Synch settings to confirm it has finished; a vault appearing on this website does not confirm that files have synced.
vaults.setupConnectIntro: The remote vault is available. Connect it inside Obsidian to sync files on this device.
vaults.noManagedOrganizationHelp: Vault management is available to organization owners and administrators. If you are a member, connect to your shared vaults in Obsidian.
vaults.refreshFailed: The latest vault list could not be loaded. Refresh to continue.
vaults.title: Remote vaults
vaults.subtitle: Manage the encrypted vaults attached to this Synch account. Deleting a remote vault does not delete local Obsidian files.
vaults.createIntro: The vault key is generated in your browser and encrypted with your vault password. The password and the unencrypted key are never sent to the server.
vaults.createPasswordHint: Keep this password safe. If it is lost, recovery requires another vault administrator who still has the vault key.
vaults.createdVault: {name} created. Connect it from Obsidian with the same vault password.
vaults.cryptoLoadFailed: Unable to load the encryption module. Refresh the page and try again.
vaults.passwordOuterSpaces: Password cannot start or end with spaces.
vaults.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least {count} characters.
vaults.passwordMaxLength: Password must be {count} characters or fewer.
vaults.passwordTooWeak: Password is too easy to guess. Use a longer passphrase.
vaults.passwordRepeatedCharacter: Password cannot be one repeated character.
vaults.passwordSimpleSequence: Password cannot be a simple sequence.
vaults.confirmLabel: Type the vault name to confirm
vaults.empty: No remote vaults are attached to this account.
vaults.emptyOrganization: No remote vaults in this organization.
vaults.emptyGuideIntro: Create your first remote vault with the Create vault button above, or from inside Obsidian. Synch keeps your vault end-to-end encrypted; connect the vault in Obsidian to start syncing files.
vaults.emptyGuideInstallBody: Open Obsidian Settings, go to Community plugins, select Browse, search for Synchrun, then install and enable it.
vaults.emptyGuideSignInBody: Open Synch settings inside Obsidian and sign in with this Synch account.
vaults.emptyGuideCreateBody: Back up your local Obsidian vault, then choose Create vault in Synch settings. Enter a vault name and create the remote vault from that local vault.
vaults.emptyGuidePasswordBody: Set a vault password when creating the vault. It is used locally to wrap the encryption key before upload, so keep it somewhere safe.
vaults.emptyGuideDeviceBody: On the other device, install Synch, sign in with the same account, choose Connect vault, select the existing remote vault, and enter the same vault password.
vaults.deleteCopy: This permanently removes remote vault "{name}" from this account. Local Obsidian files are not deleted.

organizations.sharingUpgradeBody: Invite members and sync vaults together with Plus.
organizations.sharingPausedBody: Activate Plus to resume shared sync. Your data is preserved.
organizations.sharingContactOwner: Contact your server administrator to restore sharing.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.subtitle: Manage members, invitations, and access to encrypted vaults.
organizations.name: Organization name
organizations.copyLink: Copy this invitation link and share it with the invited person. They must sign in with the invited email address.
organizations.removeConfirm: Stop this person’s sync access? Files already downloaded to their devices remain there.
organizations.pendingRefresh: Access is revoked. Existing connections are being closed; refresh to check again.
organizations.noVaults: No vaults available. Create a vault from Remote vaults.
organizations.sharingRequired: Organization sharing is available with Plus or on self-hosted servers.
organizations.suspended: Shared sync is paused. Data is preserved and access resumes when Plus is renewed.
organizations.plusLimits: Plus: 3 members including the owner · 3 vaults · 5 GB per vault · 100 MB per file · 1 year of history

invitations.wrongAccount: This invitation is unavailable for this account. Sign in with the email address that received the invitation.
invitations.title: Organization invitation
invitations.missing: Open the invitation link provided by your administrator.
invitations.next: Invitation accepted. Continue key setup in Obsidian.
